Alternative Fangan Tools

DREditor may not be the tool for everyone. So we've compiled a list of alternative tools to use for your fangans! If you are making a Fangan Tool and would like to be added this list, please email dreditortool@gmail.com or reach out to sweden_gaming on discord!

DanganMake


Danganmake is a free program made to create your own Danganronpa without coding anything! Create your own stories, characters, music, stages, and more!
